svg.title: Deep Equilibrium Models: endpoint, solver and implicit gradient
svg.desc: An unrolled shared block stores intermediate activations. A DEQ instead solves f(z*, x) = z*, then solves a linear system at the endpoint for parameter gradients. Iterative numerical work remains.
svg.text: Define the endpoint. Solve for it. Differentiate it.
Same block, input x at every update
Backpropagation retains a path of intermediate activations.
Finite solver iterations remain; z* is approximated numerically.
Local derivatives replace differentiation through the forward solver path.
J = derivative with respect to state; B = derivative with respect to parameters.
Depth-independent activation storage does not mean constant total GPU memory.
